answer_1.quote: We evaluate the relationship between machine translation difficulty and the degree of synthesis or fusion ... using English‑Turkish, English‑Spanish, English‑German (both directions) evaluation sets.
answer_1.outputs: system‑generated translations compared against gold‑standard references

answer_2.quote: We compute automatic evaluation metrics (BLEU, chrF and/or COMET) with respect to the reference set, per sentence.

answer_4.quote: We performed a human evaluation of a sample of sentences on (10%) of each evaluation set, focusing on two scores: Semantic score ... and Grammar score ... Annotators were native speakers and PhD students in Linguistics.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators rated each translated word on a 4‑point Semantic scale (relationship between lemmas) and a 3‑point Grammar scale (inflection correctness).
